set.body:
Extract the general recall-to-video pipeline out of the Sherlock bench file.

Owner directive (2026-09-01): the deliverable is a general method - a recall transcript
(normally with word timestamps) against a video - not a Sherlock analysis. The alignment core
already is general; the debt is that the general middle layer lives in a Sherlock-named file:
the timestamped-transcript reader, the word-onset-to-unit timing, the anchor confidence, and
above all the view-building recipe (concatenate segment texts into a derived document, spans
become supports, succession edges from temporal order, media loci beside the view).

Slice, all inside embed-bench (no portable-module change, no new dependency edge):
- New package storymodel4s.bench.video with the general contract:
  - MediaLocus (partId + PlaybackInterval | PlaybackInstant) - general vocabulary for "where
    a node lives in a playable video";
  - TimedSegment(ordinal, text, locus, group, extraLemmas, locations) + Group(ordinal, label):
    the general input - any time-aligned text over video, grouping optional;
  - TimedSourceView.build(segments, axes, naming) -> Built(view, media, document,
    segmentByRef, groupByRef, nodeTexts): the generalized recipe, group hulls minted on the
    part's own PresentationAxis, naming owned by the adapter so IDs stay deterministic;
  - RecallWordsCsv, RecallTiming, AnchorConfidence moved verbatim;
  - RecallToVideo.run(built, words, axes, label, out): the orchestration and report writer,
    seconds and timecodes derived per part from each axis's own rational timebase (no global
    ticks-per-second assumption).
- SherlockRecallMapping shrinks to an adapter: atlas -> TimedSegments + axes + naming, then
  the general runner. Sherlock's MediaLocus converts to the general one at this boundary.
- Report columns "scene"/"annotationDescription" become "group"/"sourceSegmentText".

Verification: suite moves with the logic plus a new flat-build court (segments without
grouping must build a leaf-only view - the case Sherlock never exercises); regenerated NN01
report must be data-identical to the pre-refactor artifact (headers renamed by intent).

Not in this slice: promoting the video package to a portable module (needs an ADR and a
second consumer); a perception-channel adapter producing TimedSegments from raw video.
set.title: General recall-to-video pipeline extracted from the Sherlock runner
